label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee feast/surprise for the mayor, including 201 fresh loaves and eight lanterns arranged in the great hall, with the mayor brought in at 18:00 unaware beforehand. The mayor was not told the surprise in advance; they were told it was a routine hall lighting/table inspection and approved that appointment. Baker baked; innkeeper organized funding/provisions; Freight coordinated and transported; builder handled lighting and hall/arrival arrangements; neighbour fetched and installed lanterns, carried bread, and agreed to bring the mayor discreetly. The record establishes these people as participants/helpers; it does not establish additional knowingly involved people among the townsfolk or secretary.
